column1: 10 stages. Element counts are in the Elements tab.

column3: The route decision D6 approves a restructure, or D5 proposes one
column4: Plan runs to term and the case closes; Plan breaks and the case returns to the route decision; Customer does not sign and the case returns to its prior status in COLLINS; A second break bars a further restructure

column3: The route decision D6 approves a settlement
column4: Payment clears, the collateral is released and the case closes; The customer does not pay by the deadline and the case returns to the route decision; A payment reverses after release and the case re-opens

column1: Deed in lieu and voluntary surrender
column3: The route decision D6 approves a deed in lieu, or the customer offers the asset during a negotiation
column4: The asset is on the books and hands off to the disposal route; The customer rents the asset back and the rental runs; The customer withdraws or the title is not clean and the case returns to the route decision

column3: The route decision D6.3 approves litigation, or a broken treatment returns the case to the legal route
column4: Debt satisfied and the case closes; Asset taken onto the books and handed to the disposal route; Judgment unenforceable or enforcement exhausted, and the case goes to write-off; Customer cures or settles, and the case returns to treatment

column3: A guarantee is detected on the case at takeover and the claim deadline timer starts
column4: The claim is paid and the residual returns to the route decision; The claim is lost on the deadline and the full balance returns to the route decision; The guarantor settles and the case closes

column3: An asset is taken onto the bank's books and the holding age clock starts
column4: Sold, proceeds applied and the case closed with no shortfall; Sold with a residual, handed to debt sale or write-off; Transferred to RAMC or the joint venture; Rented, with the asset still held

column3: The monthly debt sale cycle opens, or a residual arrives from the disposal route
column4: Lot awarded, settled, transferred and closed with realized recovery recorded; Lot withdrawn and the accounts returned to the case list; Put-back upheld and the account returned to the bank

column1: Write off and recover after charge-off, D9
column3: The monthly eligibility scan runs on the cut-off date, or a residual arrives from another route
column4: Posted, placed, recovered and closed after the retention period; Rejected by the committee and returned to the pursue track; Sold to a buyer as a charged-off population

column3: The screening agent flags a deviation at entry or on a new document
column4: The deviation clears and the case returns to the state it paused in; The deviation moves the case to a different route; The case ends, where insurance settles the debt

column3: The case is in any active state on any route
column4: The case returns to the state it was in; The case moves to the route decision; The case closes; The case is canceled or merged
